line: Pistol first. Lay it on the black mat, flat.

speaker: npc_brann

line: Hold on it and circle the mouse slow. Feel it bite.

line: Hold it on the card. It wanders. Fire when it's on.

speaker: npc_brann
line: Tool on the mark, then click. Just the mark.

speaker: npc_brann
line: Hold it and shake the mouse. Short and sharp.

line: Hold and follow the line. Steady pace, don't rush it.

line: Hold to lift, let go to strike. Higher hits harder.

line: Hold it down and listen. Let go when it sounds right.

line: Something's still holding it. Free that first.

line: Not that one yet. Look for what's lit.

speaker: npc_brann
line: You'll want a tool for that.

speaker: npc_brann
line: Wrong tool for that. Put it back.

speaker: npc_brann
line: Frame in the vise. Snug, not tight, or you'll mark it.

line: Cutters. Snip both wire twists on the old grip.

line: Peel the tape off. Find the loose end and follow it round.

line: Bent it. On the vise, tap it straight.

line: Slide the housing off. Thumb on that spring, it jumps.

line: Brush it. The screws are under that muck.

speaker: npc_brann
line: Case screws. Cross bit this time.

line: That one's chewed. Squeeze the pliers first, then turn.

line: Pick in the seam. Three clips. Lean, don't stab.

line: Gears off. Top one first.

line: Pick the grit out. Three little holes.

line: One drop on each trunnion. One.

line: Flick the rotor. Listen to it.

line: Probes across the resistor. Lamp should light.

line: Strap in the vise. Bend it to the mark. Twice.

line: Pin's proud. Tap it flush.

speaker: npc_brann
line: New screws from the dish. Cross bit.

line: Old bits in the bin. Pistol on the mat. Cell in.
